Frequently Asked Questions

Common queries regarding Oregon renters insurance.

Is renters insurance required by law in Oregon?

No, state law does not mandate renters insurance. However, the majority of landlords and property management companies require proof of a policy before signing a lease.

Does standard renters insurance cover natural disasters?

Standard policies exclude earth movement and floods. You may need a separate policy or endorsement for comprehensive hazard protection.

How much liability coverage should I have?

$100,000 is the standard baseline, but raising it to $300,000 often costs only a few extra dollars a month and provides significantly better protection.
